title: Nice Shot (Wii Sports)
blurb: Chipper, immediate and entirely unearned — the most sincere compliment in gaming history, offered by a man who cannot see what you did. Wii Sports golf hands out this praise generously, and the nostalgia attached runs deep for anyone whose family spent 2007 swinging a remote at a television. The meme value lies in ironic deployment: play it for terrible decisions executed confidently, parallel parking attempts that require four goes, and any shot that was demonstrably not nice. The announcer believes in you even when he really should not.
origin: The announcer compliment from Wii Sports (Nintendo, 2006).
